de: The authorities of Nepal, which was badly affected last August by a landslide and subsequent mudflows, reduced the time limit for recognizing people as missing.

te: Buried hooves: in the Arctic, potatoes began to fertilize with reindeer waste
de: Agrarians of the NAO began to use deer hooves in the cultivation of Arctic varieties of potatoes. Bone-hoofed meal, which is obtained during the processing of reindeer herding waste, was proposed to be used as a fertilizer by scientists.
